verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs describe incremental rollouts: a new deployment can be sent to a percentage of traffic first, then promoted or rolled back. Instant rollback without a rebuild further limits blast radius. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of rollout configuration (step sizes, scheduling, metric-based automatic promotion or abort), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can roll out new deployments incrementally to reduce blast radius

citations.quote: Roll out new deployments in increments.
Send a new deployment to a percentage of traffic first, then promote it or roll back.
Revert production to a previous deployment without a rebuild when something breaks.
